podcast.title: Connection to Sharon Sheely and Eddie Cochran
podcast.body: Derry Weaver dated Mary Jo Sheely, the sister of Sharon Sheely. Sharon became interested in Weaver and his friends, suggesting Jet Power change his name to PJ Probe and regularly having him sing on her song demos in the 1960s. Sharon also introduced Weaver to Eddie Cochran and Jerry K-Part. "Meanwhile, Derri Weaver from the moon dogs had started to date Mary Jo Sheely, the sister of Sharon and Sharon started to take an interest in her little sister's boyfriend and his friends."

srcs.source: A History of Rock Music in 500 Songs

podcast.title: Fall into Obscurity
podcast.body: After several years of session work, Derry Weaver fell into obscurity. "We won't be seeing anything more from Derri Weaver, who fell into obscurity after a few years of session work."

srcs.source: A History of Rock Music in 500 Songs

podcast.title: Haunted by Eddie Cochran's Death
podcast.body: Weaver was living at the Sheely Residence when he received the phone call informing them of Eddie Cochran's death and Sharon Sheely's hospitalization. This tragic event deeply affected him and haunted him for the rest of his life. "Weaver was actually living it the Shealy Residence, when they received the phone call saying that Eddie had died and Shaman was in hospital, and it haunted him deeply for the rest of his life."

srcs.source: A History of Rock Music in 500 Songs
